## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Owner-bound slice only: `adopt_subject(binding, environment, ports)*`
   in-process adoption through the existing runtime per admitted PADR-R5-1*
   (A.2 owner seam hh-embed arming/drive) — reuses the existing runtime,
   one subject, the current fenced writer; no public RPC, no second run,
   no copied runtime (AC-1, AC-2).
2. Positive: admitted in-process adoption validates
   run/plan/attempt/config/environment/root/generation, arms or resumes
   the existing runtime, observes one subject/writer through the existing
   port; record smallest supported composition + absent capabilities (AC-1).
3. Negative: finished, stale, duplicate, mismatched-root/environment or
   missing-writer adoption refuses; no second run or copied runtime; later
   real bridge/settlement proofs linked as contributing evidence, never
   claimed by a fixture (AC-2).
4. Ownership/evidence: primary REQ-E-201 + REQ-C-103 predicates/aliases
   resolved to numbered checks + actual evidence in the coverage register;
   achieved D/E recorded separately from owed R/P/actual-execution E;
   required contributor evidence R5.8/R5.6/R5.14/R5.10 named as owed
   (AC-3).
5. Scoped verification: regression fails without the behavior;
   `cargo fmt --all --check` + owning-package tests; drift/removability/
   CI-mode checks only if their surface is touched; scratch stores (AC-4).
6. Universal phase gate: green in scope; REQ ids stamped; owed predicates
   as DEFERRALS rows with owner/trigger/control; ADRs for owned decisions;
   run/PR/BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER agree; O-01–O-08 and I-01–I-08 dispositions
   (AC-5).

## Acceptance criteria (from the contract)

- [ ] AC-1 (D/E; positive): in-process adoption validates
       run/plan/attempt/config/environment/root/generation; arms or
       resumes existing runtime; observes one subject/writer through the
       existing port; smallest composition + absent capabilities recorded.
- [ ] AC-2 (D/E; negative): finished, stale, duplicate,
       mismatched-root/environment, missing-writer refusals; no second
       run/copied runtime.
- [ ] AC-3 (D/E; ownership+evidence): REQ-E-201 + REQ-C-103 mapped to
       numbered checks + actual evidence; D/E vs owed recorded;
       contributor evidence R5.8/R5.6/R5.14/R5.10 owed.
- [ ] AC-4 (E/D; scoped verification): fails-without regression; fmt +
       owning-package tests; counts recorded; scratch stores.
- [ ] AC-5 (D/E; universal gate): green scope; REQ ids stamped; records
       agree; operating clauses + invariants.

## Plan

1. `crates/hh-embed/src/adopt.rs` (new module; `impl EmbedService`) —
   `adopt_subject(AdoptBinding, &EnvironmentInput, &AdoptPorts) →
   AdoptOutcome`, the in-process owner seam (no RPC per dossier
   non-admission ledger):
   - validate (all pre-mutation): presented binding `phase=="bound"`;
     `subject_writer` present and run-scoped; `has_run`; subject run not
     `lifecycle.run.finished`; no live writer session on the run
     (`adopt_duplicate`); manifest ↔ `binding.inputs` members
     (run_kind, experiment_run_id, attempt_no, cell_id, arm_id,
     replicate_index, task_id, configuration_id,
     configuration_version_id, funding_slice); subject root =
     `control.budget.allocated` parentless row ==
     `subject_root_budget_id` (`adopt_root_mismatch`); durable env check
     (prior `action.environment.declared` must re-derive the same
     `{class,image}` — `adopt_environment_mismatch`).
   - durable binding re-read: `engine_for` →
     `launch_binding(run_plan_id)` must equal the presented record
     (`adopt_stale_binding` — R5.6's admitted reader, never
     caller-trusted).
   - writer: `store.renew(subject_writer)` proves the exact lease
     live (generation/lease_id/expiry) and extends it — a
     fenced/expired/superseded lease is `adopt_writer_stale` before any
     subject-run mutation.
   - arm or resume through the existing runtime:
     `provision_environment` on a never-provisioned subject (a matched
     prior declared env is reused, not re-minted);
     `lifecycle.session.attached{mode:"adopt", intent_ref, run_plan_id,
     attempt_no}` — existing class, extended members (dossier A.3);
     `leaf.arm`+`leaf.checkpoint` present ⇒ `arm_resume_driver`
     (resumed), else `arm_driver` (armed) with the smallest composition
     (`driver_surfaces(ports.host_caps)`, `hh/react-minimal`, `static`
     compute, no sealed doc, no budget input).
   - session state mirrors the open/resume builders (mem_ctx fold,
     realized settings from the manifest, `persist_leaf`).
2. Visibility bumps: `environment_spec`, `budget_dimensions` → `pub(crate)`
   (adopt.rs consumes the same constructions — never a second rule).
3. Tests `crates/hh-embed/tests/r5_7.rs` — scratch-store acceptance
   battery: launch a real subject through `ExperimentEngine` over the
   same store root, then `EmbedService::open` + `adopt_subject`.
4. ADR — owned landing decisions (binding re-read, renew-as-validation,
   env reuse, session.attached extension, minimal composition).
5. Gate-status verbatim into the contract; run ledger; PR; close.
